topics.title: Meet a new classmate
topics.task: You meet a new student your age on the first day of school.
topics.partner: a friendly French classmate called Léa, who is meeting you for the first time
topics.starter: Salut ! Moi, c'est Léa. Et toi, comment tu t'appelles ?

topics.title: Greet your teacher
topics.task: You meet your French teacher in the corridor and must be polite.
must: Greet and ask how they are
topics.partner: your French teacher, Madame Martin, who always uses vous with students she does not know well
topics.starter: Bonjour ! Comment allez-vous aujourd'hui ?

topics.title: Introduce yourself
topics.task: A coordinator of an international school camp asks you to introduce yourself.
topics.partner: a friendly camp coordinator who interviews each new participant
topics.starter: Bonjour et bienvenue au camp ! Peux-tu te présenter ?

topics.title: Where are you from?
topics.task: You chat with a student from Québec at a language camp and compare your countries.
must: Say what city you live in
topics.partner: a student from Montréal called Samuel, curious about Czechia
topics.starter: Salut ! Moi, je viens du Canada. Et toi, tu viens d'où ?

topics.title: Numbers game
topics.task: The partner says numbers, ages and phone numbers and you repeat or answer them.
must: Give your age and a phone number
topics.partner: a playful quiz host who asks short questions with numbers (ages, prices, phone numbers, dates)
topics.starter: C'est parti pour le jeu des chiffres ! Première question : quel âge as-tu ?

topics.title: Tell me about your family
topics.task: Your host family wants to know who is in your family.
must: Say who is in your family
Say if you have brothers or sisters
phrases: Dans ma famille, il y a ...
topics.partner: a curious host mother called Mme Dubois who asks about your family
topics.starter: Alors, parle-moi de ta famille ! Tu as des frères et sœurs ?

topics.title: Pets
topics.task: You talk to a classmate who loves animals.
must: Say if you have a pet
topics.partner: a classmate called Chloé who loves animals
topics.starter: Tu as un animal à la maison ? Moi, j'ai deux chats !

topics.title: Describe a friend
topics.task: You describe your best friend to someone who has never met them.
topics.partner: a French friend who wants to imagine your best friend and asks questions
topics.starter: Alors, c'est qui, ton meilleur ami ? Il est comment ?

topics.title: Guess who
topics.task: You describe a famous person without naming them and the partner guesses. Then you swap.
topics.partner: a cheerful game partner who plays Guess Who with famous people
topics.starter: On joue à Qui est-ce ? Tu commences : décris une personne célèbre !

topics.title: Your hobbies
topics.task: A new pen pal asks about your free time.
must: Say what you like and dislike
Ask the partner a question back
topics.partner: a pen pal called Maxime who loves hobbies and asks many questions
topics.starter: Salut ! Qu'est-ce que tu aimes faire pendant ton temps libre ?

topics.title: Your sport
topics.task: A French school magazine journalist interviews you about your sport.
must: Say what you like about it
topics.partner: a young journalist for a school magazine
topics.starter: Bonjour ! Je prépare un article sur les sportifs. Quel sport est-ce que tu pratiques ?

topics.title: Music
topics.task: You talk about music with a French student who plays an instrument.
must: Say what music you listen to
topics.partner: a student called Hugo who plays the guitar in a band
topics.starter: Salut ! Tu aimes la musique ? Moi, je joue de la guitare.

topics.title: Twenty questions
topics.task: You ask yes or no questions to find out which animal or object the partner thinks of.
topics.partner: a game host who thinks of an animal and answers only oui or non
topics.starter: Je pense à un animal. Pose-moi des questions pour le deviner !

topics.title: Your school
topics.task: A French exchange student asks about your school.
must: Give an opinion about a subject
topics.partner: an exchange student called Inès who will visit your school next month
topics.starter: Salut ! Je vais venir dans ton collège. C'est comment, ton collège ?

topics.title: Compare timetables
topics.task: You and a French friend compare your school days.
must: Say what time school starts and ends
topics.partner: a French friend called Théo who compares school timetables with you
topics.starter: Moi, je commence à huit heures. Et toi, tu commences à quelle heure ?

topics.title: Your daily routine
topics.task: A French friend is doing a project on the days of teenagers.
must: Say when you get up and go to bed
topics.partner: a French friend called Camille who is doing a school project about daily routines
topics.starter: Pour mon projet, je pose la même question à tout le monde : tu fais quoi pendant une journée normale ?

topics.title: At the restaurant
topics.task: You order a meal in a French restaurant.
must: Order a drink and a main course
Ask a question about the menu
topics.partner: a polite waiter in a small restaurant
topics.starter: Bonjour ! Bienvenue. Vous avez choisi ?

topics.title: Food with your host family
topics.task: Your host parent plans meals for your stay and asks about your tastes.
must: Say what you like and cannot eat
Say what you eat for breakfast
topics.partner: a host parent called M. Roux who wants you to feel at home
topics.starter: Pendant ton séjour, je voudrais cuisiner des choses que tu aimes. Qu'est-ce que tu manges au petit-déjeuner ?

topics.title: At the bakery
topics.task: You buy bread and pastries.
must: Ask for at least three items
topics.partner: a baker at a French boulangerie
topics.starter: Bonjour ! Qu'est-ce que je vous sers ?

topics.title: At the market
topics.task: You buy fruit and vegetables for a family dinner.
topics.partner: a friendly market vendor
topics.starter: Bonjour, jeune homme ! Ce sont des fraises superbes aujourd'hui. Qu'est-ce qu'il vous faut ?

topics.title: Your home
topics.task: A French friend will visit you and wants to know about your home.
topics.partner: a French friend called Louise who is coming to visit
topics.starter: Je viens chez toi bientôt ! Tu habites dans une maison ou dans un appartement ?

topics.title: Show your room
topics.task: You show your room to a friend on a video call.
must: Say what you do in your room
phrases: Le bureau est à côté de ...
Sur le mur, il y a ...
topics.partner: a friend on a video call who asks to see everything
topics.starter: Montre-moi ta chambre ! Qu'est-ce qu'il y a ?

topics.title: Give directions
topics.task: A tourist is lost in your town and asks the way.
topics.partner: a tourist looking for the train station
topics.starter: Excusez-moi, pouvez-vous m'aider ? Je cherche la gare.

topics.title: Plan Saturday
topics.task: A friend invites you out and you plan the day together.
topics.partner: a friend called Lucas who wants to do something on Saturday
topics.starter: Salut ! Samedi, on fait quelque chose ensemble ? Qu'est-ce que tu veux faire ?

topics.title: Weather and plans
topics.task: You decide with a friend what to do depending on the weather.
must: Make a plan A and a plan B
topics.partner: a French friend called Manon who checks the weather forecast
topics.starter: Regarde la météo ! Demain, il va faire quoi, à ton avis ?

topics.title: Your birthday
topics.task: A friend helps plan your birthday.
must: Say who you want to invite
Say what you want to do
topics.partner: a friend called Jade who is helping you plan your party
topics.starter: Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ? Qu'est-ce qu'on organise ?

topics.title: In the clothes shop
topics.task: You look for clothes in a shop.
must: Say what you are looking for
topics.partner: a shop assistant in a clothes shop
topics.starter: Bonjour ! Je peux vous aider ?

topics.title: Fashion opinions
topics.task: A friend who loves fashion asks your opinion about clothes and brands.
topics.partner: a friend called Sarah who is passionate about fashion
topics.starter: Moi, j'adore la mode. Et toi, tu fais attention à tes vêtements ?

topics.title: Last weekend
topics.task: A friend asks what you did last weekend.
must: Tell at least four things in order
topics.partner: a friend called Antoine who asks a lot of follow-up questions
topics.starter: Salut ! Tu as passé un bon week-end ? Raconte !

topics.title: A match you played
topics.task: You tell a friend about a match you played.
must: Say who you played and where
Say the result and how you felt
topics.partner: a friend who was not at the match and wants all the details
topics.starter: Alors, ton dernier match, c'était comment ?

topics.title: When you were little
topics.task: A French grandparent asks what your childhood was like.
topics.partner: a kind French grandfather who loves hearing stories
topics.starter: Dis-moi, quand tu étais petit, comment c'était ta vie ?

topics.title: Your best holiday
topics.task: You tell about the best holiday you have had.
must: Tell what happened with the passé composé
topics.partner: a friend who is looking for ideas for a holiday
topics.starter: Je cherche des idées pour les vacances. C'était où, tes meilleures vacances ?

topics.title: At the hotel
topics.task: You check in at a hotel.
phrases: Le petit-déjeuner est à quelle heure ?
topics.partner: a hotel receptionist who speaks politely
topics.starter: Bonsoir et bienvenue à l'hôtel. Vous avez une réservation ?

topics.title: Plan a trip
topics.task: You plan a trip with a travel agent.
must: Say where you want to go
Say when and for how long
topics.partner: a travel agent with many questions
topics.starter: Bonjour ! Vous avez un projet de voyage ?

topics.title: At the doctor
topics.task: You are ill and talk to a doctor.
must: Say how long you have felt ill
topics.partner: a doctor who asks short questions
topics.starter: Bonjour. Qu'est-ce qui ne va pas ?

topics.title: At the pharmacy
topics.task: You buy medicine at the pharmacy.
topics.partner: a pharmacist
topics.starter: Bonjour, vous désirez ?

topics.title: Healthy habits
topics.task: The school nurse asks about your habits.
must: Say what you eat and drink
Say how much you sleep and move
topics.partner: a friendly school nurse
topics.starter: Bonjour ! On parle un peu de tes habitudes. Tu dors combien d'heures par nuit ?

topics.title: Your favourite game
topics.task: A French friend asks about the game you love (for example Minecraft).
must: Name the game and explain it
Say what you like and dislike
topics.partner: a friend who does not play video games but is curious
topics.starter: Tu joues beaucoup aux jeux vidéo, non ? Explique-moi ton jeu préféré !

topics.title: Screens: good or bad?
topics.task: A friend thinks screens are bad. You discuss.
topics.partner: a friend who thinks young people spend far too much time on screens
topics.starter: Moi, je trouve qu'on passe trop de temps sur les écrans. Tu es d'accord ?

topics.title: Celebrations
topics.task: A French friend wants to know how people celebrate in Czechia.
must: Say what people do and eat
Say what you like about it
topics.partner: a French friend called Alice who is curious about other traditions
topics.starter: Dis-moi, comment est-ce que vous fêtez Noël chez toi ?

topics.title: Plan a party
topics.task: You and a friend plan a party together.
topics.partner: a friend called Nina who is good at organizing
topics.starter: Alors, cette fête, on l'organise où et quand ?

topics.title: Your future job
topics.task: A careers adviser asks what you want to do later.
must: Say what you need to study
topics.partner: a careers adviser at a school
topics.starter: Bonjour ! Alors, qu'est-ce que tu aimerais faire plus tard ?

topics.title: If you could
topics.task: A friend asks what you would like to do in life.
must: Say one place you would visit
topics.partner: a friend who likes big dreams
topics.starter: Si tu pouvais faire n'importe quoi, qu'est-ce que tu voudrais faire dans la vie ?

topics.title: Should school start later?
topics.task: You debate whether school should start at 9 o'clock.
topics.partner: a debate partner who takes the opposite side and argues politely
topics.starter: Moi, je pense que l'école doit commencer à huit heures. Pourquoi serait-ce un problème ?

topics.title: Compulsory competitive sport
topics.task: You debate whether competitive sport should be compulsory at school.
must: Use the subjonctif at least once
topics.partner: a debate partner who disagrees with you in a friendly way
topics.starter: Selon moi, le sport de compétition à l'école, c'est une mauvaise idée. Qu'est-ce que tu en penses ?

topics.title: Summer job interview
topics.task: You are interviewed for a summer job and must use vous.
must: Explain why you want the job
Talk about your skills and availability
topics.partner: an interviewer at a holiday camp who asks formal questions
topics.starter: Bonjour, merci d'être venu. Présentez-vous, s'il vous plaît.

topics.title: A childhood memory
topics.task: You tell a detailed memory from your childhood.
must: Set the scene with the imparfait
Tell events with the passé composé
Use the plus-que-parfait at least once
topics.partner: a friend who asks about the details and your feelings
topics.starter: Raconte-moi un souvenir d'enfance que tu n'oublieras jamais.

topics.title: If you were rich
topics.task: A friend asks what you would do with a lot of money.
must: Say one idea for helping others
topics.partner: a friend who loves hypothetical questions
topics.starter: Imagine : tu gagnes un million d'euros demain. Qu'est-ce que tu fais ?

topics.title: Recommend a film or series
topics.task: You recommend a film or series to a friend and explain why.
topics.partner: a friend who is looking for something to watch
topics.starter: Je cherche un bon film ou une bonne série. Qu'est-ce que tu me conseilles ?

topics.title: Complain about a product
topics.task: You return a faulty product to a shop and explain the problem.
must: Ask for a refund or exchange
topics.partner: a shop employee who is polite but careful with refunds
topics.starter: Bonjour, que puis-je faire pour vous ?
